enchantments.tooltip: Draconic Mind: While an Epic-level Helm of the Blue Dragon is equipped at the same time as a Flawless Blue Dragonscale Armor, you will gain a +15 artifact bonus to your Universal Spell Power.

enchantments.text: One of the following ability bonuses:

children.tooltip: Charisma +8: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Charisma +3: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Intelligence +8: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Wisdom +8: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Insightful Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
